- Year 2: 10%, 
- Year 3: 10%, 
- Year 4: 15%, 
- Year 5: 25%, 
- Year 6: 0%, 
- Year 7: 0%, 
- Year 8-10: 20%. Note: This structure is designed to minimize concentration risk, with no more than 30% of the portfolio maturing in any single year and allowing for some flexibility in case of future market downturns. This is consistent with the investment strategy and aims to ensure capital preservation and predictable income.
